info.name: Long and Dangerous Road of an Agent

descriptions.notStarted: I lost the Parachute Agent Shoes that Gaga gave to me recently during his suspicious offer.  I feel bad asking for another pair now, but should I still ask #bGaga#k?
descriptions.inProgress: Gaga seemed overly touched by the encouragement I gave in passing.  I think he is going to give me the Parachute Agent Shoes again.  I should talk to #bGaga#k again.
descriptions.completed: Gaga gave me the Parachute Agent Shoes again without any conditions.  I feel bad for doubting him all this time...
